qualitative_review.claim: Current labels use the target-building LOBO fold; old TARGET events are revalidated and preserved by original identity.
Mixed D is retained unless an old specific design requires otherwise; filtered stock is not called a new uniform current-label sample.
Six directions share three physical pair contrasts; opposite signs and intervals are mirror displays, not independent replications.
Different class-pair support and different n/m/backgrounds are not treated as controlled transitivity or replacement-ratio experiments.
Stable-anchor vote crossing is associated with larger changes but is neither a causal randomized intervention nor sufficient for improvement.
Unchanged node count and connection can coexist with geometry and Q changes; the 0.82px example does not alone explain 15.171Q.
More recalled corners can coexist with lower Q and poorer range/direction.
Source-ring count zero is a native algorithm failure state, not proof that no topology is possible; Q remains missing.
High-score compression partly follows from the bounded score and does not determine within- versus cross-class change.
Mean component changes are not misused as causal score contributions; finite-change formula attribution is explicitly arithmetic.
